title: Adaptive designs (FDA guidance)
source_note: FDA Adaptive Designs guidance (2016 draft in the knowledge bank; final Nov 2019)

items.title: Prospective planning
items.requirement: All adaptations, their timing and decision rules are prospectively specified.

items.title: Type I error control
items.requirement: Control of the type I error rate is demonstrated analytically or by simulation.
items.query: control of type I error rate adaptive design

items.title: Simulation report
items.requirement: Simulations cover realistic scenarios and report power, type I error, sample size distribution and estimation bias.

items.title: Estimation
items.requirement: Bias in treatment effect estimates and confidence interval coverage are addressed.

items.title: Trial integrity
items.requirement: Access to interim results is restricted (firewall, DMC / adaptation committee, charter).
items.query: maintaining trial integrity confidentiality interim results data monitoring committee

items.title: Interim timing and data quality
items.requirement: Interim timing (information fraction) and data quality at the interim are addressed.
items.query: interim analysis timing information data quality

items.title: Sample size re-estimation
items.requirement: Any sample size re-estimation states blinded vs unblinded approach and its effect on error rates.

items.title: Documentation
items.requirement: Documentation for regulators (protocol, SAP, charter, simulation code/report) is described.
